precision: Frozen IID FP16 eager policy, with eligibility kept active on traffic-free ticks.
selection_rule: Prefer a donor with discovery truthful gain and context specificity both at least .05. Otherwise choose the same-island contrast in absolute ACK–REJ repeat response. The fallback diagnoses a response without assuming it helps the task.
measurement: Native prefix and first READY FINISH. Fork only the sign of the next receipt and retire the teaching request in both arms. Query unreinforced after zero, one, or eight yoked distractors in holdout.

holdout.notation: Paired percentile bootstrap over fixed held-out world seeds. No adjustment for multiple endpoints. Conditional response contrasts may be based on different eligible lives across interventions. Matched rows require every recipient arm to give the same teaching symbol at the same tick.
